issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Rill Browser
products.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
products.summaryZh: Claude Code 和 Codex 在你身边协同工作的浏览器
products.descriptionZh: Rill 是一款 AI 原生浏览器，围绕你已在使用的 Claude Code 和 Codex 构建。正常浏览网页，然后在任意页面按下 ⌘E，即可将眼前内容转化为交给智能体的任务。Rill 会找到合适的项目、传递上下文，智能体开始工作，而你继续浏览。它还会将标签页按主题归类，把你的历史记录整理成可搜索的日期，并将智能体正在处理的每个项目汇聚到一处。免费，且沿用你现有的套餐。
products.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

products.name: OpenBot
products.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer
products.summaryZh: Grok Bot 替代方案：免费、本地、开源、多人
products.descriptionZh: OpenBot 是一个面向 AI 队友的开源工作空间。可在 Mac、Windows 和 iOS 上连接 Claude、ChatGPT、Grok、OpenCode 或自定义智能体。为智能体设定清晰的角色，让它们分派任务，并邀请团队与相同的智能体实时协作。
products.description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

products.name: AUDR by Chargebee
products.tagline: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
products.summaryZh: 用于追踪代理运行成本的开放标准
products.descriptionZh: AUDR（Agent Usage Detail Record，智能体使用详情记录）是一项开放标准，用于记录谁发起了智能体运行，以及该次运行所触及的每个系统产生的成本。受电信行业通话详情记录（Call Detail Record）的启发，AUDR 定义了一套通用 JSON schema，任何执行框架、路由器或计费系统都可以生成和接收。三条核心规则使其得以运作：由执行框架生成的共享运行 ID、清晰的字段归属，以及严格的合并规则——冲突会被拒绝，更正则以新记录的形式呈现。
products.description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

products.name: Fuse AI
products.tagline: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.
products.summaryZh: 构建自定义GTM堆栈。一个SDK。一个MCP。
products.descriptionZh: 你的GTM技术栈不该需要十几个工具、订阅和API。Fuse为开发者和AI代理提供一套SDK和MCP，覆盖整个工作流。可以理解为OpenRouter × Apollo × Clay × Zapier。Fuse负责网页自动化、数据丰富、多渠道触达、工作流和AI代理。在此基础上构建无限的工作流和代理，无需为每一步拼接不同的GTM产品。
products.description: Your GTM stack shouldn’t need a dozen tools, subscriptions, and APIs. Fuse gives developers and AI agents one SDK and MCP for the entire workflow. Think OpenRouter x Apollo x Clay x Zapier. Fuse takes care of web automations, data enrichment, multi-channel outreach, workflows, and AI agents. Build unlimited workflows and agents on top, without stitching together separate GTM products for every step.

products.name: Incredible
products.tagline: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.
products.summaryZh: 氛围计算。用你的声音控制电脑。
products.descriptionZh: Incredible 是你的个人 AI 助手，能在你的电脑上完成工作。它通过观察你的操作来学习你的工作方式。在电脑上向它演示一项任务，说出步骤，之后便让它处理日常事务，从处理发票、更新 CRM 到编辑电子表格。
products.description: Incredible is your personal AI assistant that gets work done on your computer. It learns how you work by watching you do it. Show it a task on your computer, talk through the steps, and let it handle the routine from there, from processing invoices and updating your CRM to editing spreadsheets.

products.name: Extrovert
products.tagline: Run LinkedIn outreach from your agent
products.summaryZh: 从你的智能体运行 LinkedIn 外联
products.descriptionZh: 外向者帮你发现潜在客户，推荐今天该评论或私信谁，并以你的语气准备草稿。每天花20分钟审阅，或把整个工作交给你的Claude。
products.description: Extrovert finds prospects, suggests who to comment on or DM today, and prepares drafts in your voice. Review in 20 minutes a day, or hand the whole job to your Claude.

products.name: Willow Knowledge
products.tagline: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.
products.summaryZh: 你的AI已经懂你了。现在Willow也能做到。
products.descriptionZh: Willow Knowledge 让你将写作风格和个人语境从 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 或任何你使用的 AI 带入 Willow。这就像为 Willow Scribe 赋予超能力。从现在起，你的邮件、Slack 消息、提示词，或任何你书写的地方，在听写时都会听起来完全像你。
products.description: Willow Knowledge lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you use. It's like giving superpowers to Willow Scribe. From now on, your email, slack msg, prompt, or wherever you write will sound exactly like you when you dictate.

products.name: Coddy
products.tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons
products.summaryZh: 通过简短课程，以有趣的方式学习20多种编程语言
products.descriptionZh: Coddy 通过简短、互动的课程教你编程，让你真正能学完。支持 20 多种语言（Python、JS、C++、SQL、Rust、Go……），浏览器内提供带测试用例的真实代码编辑器，还有连续学习记录、每周排行榜，以及 Bugsy——一个只给提示、不给答案的 AI 导师。所有内容均免费，但有每日限额，可在网页、iOS 和 Android 上使用。目前已有 500 多万学习者。Product Hunt 访客可在 72 小时内享受任意方案 50% 折扣，自动生效。
products.description: Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

products.name: Ghostifier
products.tagline: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
products.summaryZh: 公司掌握着你的数据。Ghostifier 能让他们删除。
products.descriptionZh: Ghostifier 不是每家公司填一张表，而是从你的收件箱开始。它会找出谁持有你的数据，在第一天就帮你退订，并选择退出数据出售与共享，等过了撤回窗口后，再发送删除请求并追踪每一封回复。银行、保险公司和你的雇主不会被触及。它还会要求数据经纪商删除你的信息。Gmail 访问仅限邮件头，因此它从不读取你的邮件正文，也没有 AI：每个决定都遵循固定规则。
products.description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

products.name: NoteWorthy
products.tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device
products.summaryZh: AI加持的笔记，全部在设备端运行
products.descriptionZh: 又一个带 AI 的笔记应用？不。这个可是超强版，而且 AI 从不离开你的设备。随手记下任何内容，NoteWorthy 会自动起标题，并归档到任务、想法、信息、个人或你自定义的标签下。一键把杂乱的想法变成清晰的标题和清单。长笔记？一行摘要搞定。一切都在你的 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 上运行。离线可用，无需账户，无需订阅，没有一条笔记会被发送到服务器。免费。⚡️
products.description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

products.name: iphone-use
products.tagline: Let AI agents drive a real iPhone, even apps with no API
products.summaryZh: 让AI智能体操控真实的iPhone，即使是没有API的应用也能操作
products.descriptionZh: iphone-use 为 AI agent 提供一台真实的 iPhone：屏幕以文本形式呈现，通过 WebDriverAgent 实现点击、输入和滚动，每个操作都有诚实的反馈（已应用、未发送或未知）。屏蔽截图的支付类应用会以线框图形式返回。任务执行一次后即成为可回放的工作流，无需模型参与。提供 HTTP API、面向 Claude Code 的 21 工具 MCP 服务器，并支持从浏览器或 iOS 应用远程控制。开源，MIT 许可。
products.description: iphone-use gives an AI agent a real iPhone: the screen as text, tap, type and scroll over WebDriverAgent, with an honest answer for every action (applied, not sent, or unknown). Payment apps that block screenshots come back as a wireframe. A task done once becomes a flow that replays with no model. HTTP API, a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code, and remote control from a browser or iOS app. Open source, MIT.

products.name: ruOS
products.tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you
products.summaryZh: 一个云端桌面，AI代理为你完成工作
products.descriptionZh: ruOS 是一款内置 AI 团队的私有云桌面。无论是研究、写作还是代码，只需提出需求，智能体（Claude Code、Codex、ruflo swarms）便会执行，你可以旁观或离开。在 Mac、iPad 或 Chromebook 上通过任意浏览器打开，无需安装。文件与 AI 记忆跨设备持久保存。高级用户可获得一台真正的 Linux 主机及 MCP 服务器，让 ChatGPT 或 Claude 直接驱动。免费试用 ruOS Lite，几秒即可开始，无需注册。
products.description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

products.name: Scumble
products.tagline: The open-source editor for AI inpainting
products.summaryZh: 面向AI图像修复的开源编辑器
products.descriptionZh: Scumble 是一款免费、开源的桌面 AI 局部重绘编辑器。选中图片的一部分，说明那里应该是什么，结果就会作为独立且色彩匹配的图层呈现。可运行在你自己的 ComfyUI 或你自己的 API 密钥上：FLUX 3、GPT Image、Nano Banana 等。
products.description: Scumble is a free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting. Select part of a picture, say what belongs there, and the result lands as its own colour-matched layer. Runs on your own ComfyUI or your own API keys: FLUX 3, GPT Image, Nano Banana and more.

products.name: Doco
products.tagline: Good Company. Music that fits.
products.summaryZh: 好伙伴。契合的音乐。
products.descriptionZh: 来认识 Doco——一个富有表现力的 Android 伙伴，陪你专注、听音乐、度过日常时刻，还可选配 Windows 桌面访客。日常模式俏皮温暖；专注模式用一点友好的讽刺帮你屏蔽噪音。全程动画，零设置。连接 Spotify，Doco 会播放契合当下的音乐，贴近你的品味，也留有余地发现新东西。添加你自己的 Gemini API 密钥，即可实现基于摄像头的反应和 AI 字幕。上线前预热——请前往 getdoco.app 加入等候名单。
products.description: Meet Doco - an expressive Android companion for focus, music and everyday moments, with an optional Windows desktop visitor. Everyday mode is playful and warm; Focus mode cuts the noise with a little friendly sarcasm. Fully animated, zero setup. Connect Spotify and Doco plays music that fits the moment, staying close to your taste with room for something new. Add your own Gemini API key for camera-based reactions and AI captions. Pre-launch - join the waitlist at getdoco.app.

products.name: Pheebs
products.tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI
products.summaryZh: 衡量工程师和团队实际如何利用AI开展工作
products.descriptionZh: 衡量你和团队实际如何使用 AI 编码代理。Pheebs 是由 Eversynced 打造的开源 AI 遥测工具。它通过 hooks 静默驻留在 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 中，捕获轻量级交互信号：会话的形态，而非其内容。
products.description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

products.name: Chunk
products.tagline: The time-blocking app for macOS
products.summaryZh: macOS 上的时间块应用
products.descriptionZh: 一款适用于 Mac 的时间块应用，将任务和日历集中一处。把任务拖到某一天，它就会变成一个时间块，并显示剩余时间的倒计时。与 Google、Outlook 和 Apple 日历双向同步，并可导入 Apple 提醒事项。将顺利的一天保存为模板，或让 Claude 为你规划一周。你的数据保留在你的 Mac 上，并通过你自己的 iCloud 同步。无订阅，7 天免费，无需信用卡。
products.description: A time blocking app for Mac that puts your tasks and calendar in one place. Drag a task onto your day and it becomes a block, and a countdown shows how long is left on it. Syncs both ways with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar, and pulls in Apple Reminders. Save a good day as a template, or ask Claude to plan your week. Your data stays on your Macs and syncs through your own iCloud. No subscription, 7 days free no card required.

products.name: CodeCrab
products.tagline: 100% local-first AI pull request reviewer
products.summaryZh: 100% 本地优先的 AI 拉取请求审查器
products.descriptionZh: CodeCrab 是一款原生桌面应用，利用你本地的 CLI 在几秒内审查 Pull Request。100% 客户端运行——你的代码永远不会离开你的机器。
products.description: CodeCrab is a native desktop app that reviews Pull Requests in seconds using your local CLIs. 100% client-side — your code never leaves your machine.

products.name: Cosmic AI Support Agent
products.tagline: An AI support agent that stays in sync with your site
products.summaryZh: 与你的网站保持同步的AI支持代理
products.descriptionZh: 在你的网站上放一个 AI 支持代理，只需一个 script 标签。它根据你网站已发布的内容来回答，所以当你更新页面时，回答也会更新。设置名称、颜色、问候语和几个建议问题。当代理无法提供帮助时，访客留下邮箱和问题。你会收到邮件。他们会收到确认。试试 Leo 回答关于 Cosmic 的问题，然后激活你自己的：https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent
products.description: Put an AI support agent on your website with one script tag. It answers from the content your site already publishes, so when you update a page, the answers update too. Set the name, color, greeting, and a few suggested questions. When the agent can't help, the visitor leaves an email and the question. You get the email. They get a confirmation. Try Leo answering questions about Cosmic, then activate your own: https://www.cosmicjs.com/ai/support-agent

products.name: GeckIt
products.tagline: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats
products.summaryZh: 用于 Claude Code 聊天的看板
products.descriptionZh: 同时处理多个 Claude Code 对话？GeckIt 把它们放到看板上，让你一眼看清哪个正在运行、哪个在等你、哪个已完成。它在你自己的 Claude 订阅上运行你自己的 Claude Code，无需 API key。免费开源，支持 Mac、Windows、Linux。
products.description: Working with several Claude Code chats at once? GeckIt puts them on a Kanban board, so you see which one is working, which one waits for you and which one is done. It runs your own Claude Code on your Claude subscription, no API key. Free and open source, Mac, Windows, Linux.

products.name: EasyCut
products.tagline: Edit your Claude motion videos
products.summaryZh: 编辑你的Claude动态视频
products.descriptionZh: EasyCut 将 Claude 制作的动态视频转换为完全可编辑的时间线。每个标题、场景、图像、声音和元素都保留在各自的轨道上，因此你可以选中任意内容，让 Claude 只修改那一部分，而无需重建整个视频。调整时间、添加品牌、让音乐贴合剪辑、创建平滑慢动作、为不同平台调整尺寸，完成后即可导出。在浏览器中免费使用。你的文件保留在你的设备上。
products.description: EasyCut turns Claude-made motion videos into a fully editable timeline. Every title, scene, image, sound and element is kept on its own track, so you can select anything and ask Claude to change just that part without rebuilding the whole video. Adjust timing, add your brand, fit music to the edit, create smooth slow-mo, resize for different platforms and export when you're done. Free in your browser. Your files stay on your device.
